name: Reconstruct Governed Ontology State
purpose: Calculate a traceable governed ontology view at an exact cursor from canonical per-subject semantic histories and exact governance references, then supply bounded context projections without forking ontology truth.
inputs: canonical complete-state semantic events for identity-bearing nodes and relations
separate canonical governance events bound to exact semantic event identity, digest, and cursor
one context selector naming an exact cursor, required subjects, intended use, exact-join policy, and projection profile

promised_behaviors.statement: Calculate each node or relation semantic state from its own canonical event history and preserve its stable subject identity across lifecycle changes.
Represent lifecycle only as active, retired, or terminal removed state; creation is a transition and removed history remains replayable.
Reject an active relation unless its exact source and target nodes are active in the same consistent ontology cut.
Calculate governance separately and join it only to the semantic event whose identity, digest, and cursor all match.
Expose complete challenge instructions while keeping challenge, evidence confidence, commitment confidence, conflict, and residue as separate governance concerns.
Produce a deterministic governed-node view with exact source traceability and fail closed on stale, missing, ambiguous, or mismatched selected dependencies.
Calculate bounded context projections from one consistent source cut without making projections canonical replay sources or granting authority effects.

success: Return one deterministic, rebuildable governed ontology cut and its bounded context projection with exact event and cursor traceability.
failures: invalid lifecycle transition or event after terminal removal
missing, retired, or removed active-relation endpoint
governance reference identity, digest, or cursor mismatch
collapsed confidence axes or malformed challenge contract
unknown field outside a selected closed profile
